body.text: Estate planning is arranging, during your lifetime, what happens to your property. It aims to remove or reduce the uncertainties around it, and to cut taxes and other expenses where it can.
The goal of an estate plan comes from your own goals. It can be as simple or as complex as your needs call for.
There are five documents to consider, whatever your age, health or wealth:
Having a will does not avoid probate. If you want to avoid probate, you need a trust-based estate plan.

cards.quote: Their team took the time to explain my options, including a revocable living trust, pour-over will, and other planning tools, so I felt confident making informed decisions.
Our 20 year old wills and such were from our prior residency in Georgia and as things have changed in our lives, including moving to Florida, we needed a lot of help.
I attended the workshop as an interview of sorts to help me decide if Vaughn Law will perform this service for me. Danielle's presentation was informative and entertaining.
